verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a corporate compliance and registered-agent service, a kind of product that could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: the main host returned a Cloudflare challenge, and the legacy host redirects into it. Nothing in the pack documents an API reference or runnable examples, and lack of evidence yields "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
